topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I should have known. The attic, that overlooked nest of forgotten things, held not just cobwebs and shadows but remnants of lives past. As I sifted through, box by box, uncovering old journals, a child’s bicycle, and faded photographs, it dawned on me. I should have cleared it all away, made a clean slate. Instead, I let it remain, a silent testament to the people who once called this place home. Now, the current owners are sorting through this legacy, finding pieces of a history they didn’t sign up for. I suppose I could have spared them this, but I didn’t. I can only hope they find some value, or at least a story, in the chaos left behind.
